title: Dalvir Sidhu (Physiotherapist) — Interim Order Review
text:
Order:
The Interim Order Conditions of Practice Order made on 13 March 2025 is confirmed. The conditions are as follows:

1. Your professional practice for Connect Health must be limited to:

a) Adult male service users over the age of 18 years for face-to-face physiotherapy;

b) Telephone consultations with all service users (including females), subject to (c);

c) Team leader responsibilities including supervising and providing second opinions to colleagues, providing the colleague remains in the treatment room at all times where the patient is female.

2. You must not carry out locum/agency work.

3. You must not carry out professional work in a private practice setting.

4. You must not undertake any out-of-hours work or on-call duties.

5. You must inform the HCPC within seven days if you cease to be employed by your current employer.

6. You must inform the HCPC within seven days if you take up any other or further professional work.

7. You must inform the HCPC within seven days if you take up work requiring registration with a professional body outside the United Kingdom; and

8. You must inform the HCPC within seven days of returning to practice in the United Kingdom.

9. You must inform the HCPC within seven days of becoming aware of:

a) any investigation started against you; and

b) any disciplinary proceedings taken against you.

10. You must inform the following parties that your registration is subject to these conditions:

a) any organisation or person employing or contracting with you to undertake professional work;

b) any agency you are registered with or apply to be registered with to undertake professional work (at the time of application);

c) any prospective employer for professional work (at the time of your application);

d) any organisation through which you are undertaking any face-to- face professional training that requires HCPC registration, involving physical contact with females.

Notes:
This Order will be reviewed by the Committee no later than 6 April 2026 or earlier if new evidence which is relevant to the Order becomes available after it was made.
court: Health and Care Professions Tribunal Service
